facts.fact: The PEI Group careers page lists 3 open vacancies for its Marketing department.
A New York Network and Event Marketing vacancy on the PEI Group careers page carries an advertising salary of $60,000-$65,000.
A second New York Network and Event Marketing vacancy on the PEI Group careers page carries an advertising salary of $75,000-$80,000.
The Design marketing team has no current vacancies, according to the PEI Group careers page.
facts.quote: No current vacancies for this department

facts.fact: The PEI Membership & Events marketing team supports brand awareness, lead generation, and ecommerce sales, according to PEI's own description.
facts.quote: supports PEI to build brand awareness, generate leads, ecommerce sales, and support strong relationships with our clients
